Web Awesome 3.14.0, MIT. Source: https://github.com/shoelace-style/webawesome/tree/v3.14.0 . Official npm package @awesome.me/webawesome. Selected readable dist-cdn components and transitive chunks are included unchanged. theme.css flattens the default theme and utilities, scopes root tokens to the Enhanced Manager and optimization UI, and excludes the native/reset stylesheet. Rebuild using tools/vendor-webawesome.py with the official package extracted under /tmp/mbe-webawesome/package. No CDN runtime or Pro assets.
